pixel_convention: OpenCV pinhole: u counts columns to the right, v counts rows downward; the centre of the top-left pixel is (0, 0), so the image covers [-0.5, W - 0.5] x [-0.5, H - 0.5]; K = [[fx, 0, cx], [0, fy, cy], [0, 0, 1]]; camera axes x right, y down, z forward along the optical axis
